name: init-check-primitives-core-extraction
title: Extract init-check gate/hash primitives out of handlers for core machine
description: Backlog item recorded during B-37e9 (DONE Oracle Extraction) wrap-up on 2026-05-16. B-37e9 F-001 fixed a core/done-oracle.ts -> handlers/delivery-check.js layer violation by extracting delivery-check hash primitives into core/delivery-check-hash.ts. The same review surfaced an identical pre-existing violation: core/machine.ts:8 imports blockingInitCheckIssues / missingRequiredInitCheckAgents / recomputeInitCheckHash from ../handlers/init-check.js. core/ must not depend upward on handlers/ — and machine.ts (the xstate state machine config) carrying a reverse dependency on a handler shell is especially wrong. The three init-check primitives only need StoryStore + crypto, so the same extraction pattern applies: move them into a core module, have both handlers/init-check.ts and core/machine.ts consume core. Tracked backlog: not to be fixed now, does not block main. Out of scope: no INIT_CHECK semantics change, no reviewer flow change. Recorded as a separate story from B-4622 (scope_check_save gap) and B-da5b (heartbeat orphan) because the subject differs.
